app.name: Akinator Auto Runner
app.tagline: Auto-answer Akinator, record and replay your character knowledge base.

run.interveneTitle: You clicked "${answer}", but the auto-pick was "${original}":
run.interveneCorrectHint: Clear this question's answer distribution, keep only this answer, and overwrite the character's answer
run.interveneAppendHint: Keep the existing distribution and just add this answer to it
run.sessionInterrupted: Last run was interrupted by a reload: ${name}
run.newCharacterHint: No need to create a character first — start now and it takes shape from Akinator's guess.
run.recordIntoHint: Will record into the selected character "${name}". Pick the new-character entry to create one instead.
run.replayHint: Pick a recorded character and answer for it automatically.
run.createdHint: ${count} questions recorded — edit details or replay it.
run.mergedHint: Combined with the existing character — ${count} questions now. Edit details or replay it.
run.missing: Question missing from database — please answer.
run.needScript: The userscript is not installed in this browser — install it to run here.
run.noScriptHint: Userscript not detected — install it, then click Connect to open the Akinator window.
run.windowHint: Akinator refuses to be embedded, so Connect opens akinator.com in its own window; this page drives it and shows progress.
run.popupBlocked: The popup was blocked — allow popups for this site and try again.
run.defeat: Akinator gave up on this one.

characters.emptySite: No characters match the current filters.
characters.name: Name
characters.questionsHint: Each number is this character's weight for one answer; replay samples by weight, and saving reduces the ratios to their simplest form.
characters.noQuestions: This character has no recorded questions yet.

playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.empty: The playlist is empty — add characters from the Characters tab.
playlist.hint: Press play to run through them; the next track starts automatically.

data.noFolder: No folder linked yet; without one, data stays in browser IndexedDB.
data.cloudPacksHint: Bundled packs are fetched from this site and merged into the script database.

contribute.title: Contribute your database
contribute.hint: Export your database from the userscript and share it with the community.
contribute.onGithub: Open a pull request on GitHub

sponsor.headline: fount — an AI agent playground
sponsor.description: Build, share and run AI agents. Open source and free.
sponsor.why: This is a self-promotion slot for the fount project rather than paid advertising.

logs.title: Logs
logs.clearConfirm: Clear all logs stored on this machine?
logs.metadataSynced: Updated ${name} with the latest data from Akinator (${fields}).
logs.providerFallback: Page-driven step failed; falling back to the built-in API session.

debug.dumped: Page info dumped to clipboard and downloaded as a JSON file.

footer.text: Akinator Auto Runner — an unofficial companion for akinator.com.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Akinator. Data stays on your machine.

errors.sessionParse: Could not parse session from /game response.
errors.pageQuestionMissing: No question is in progress on the akinator page.
errors.pageStepTimeout: Timed out waiting for the akinator page to respond.
